story.title: FIFA President Proposes Review of Governance Amid Investment Controversy
story.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has called for a consultation to review the decision-making processes of the organization. This proposal follows significant backlash regarding a failed plan to introduce private investment into the World Cup. The German Football Association has criticized Infantino's initiative, suggesting it may be a tactic for his re-election.

timeline_highlights.title: FIFA President Infantino Defends World Cup Amid Criticism
timeline_highlights.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has responded to critics of the World Cup, accusing them of being 'consumed by hate' and spreading false narratives. In a strongly worded statement, he suggested that detractors should 'meditate, pray or watch a football match' instead of perpetuating negativity. Infantino defended the tournament as a celebration of unity, safety, and inclusion, dismissing concerns about corruption and disciplinary rulings.
key_facts: Gianni Infantino criticized World Cup detractors for spreading hate.
He suggested critics should meditate or watch football instead.
Infantino defended the tournament as a success celebrating unity.

timeline_highlights.title: Trump Supports Infantino Amid Accusations from Soccer Federations
timeline_highlights.summary: US President Donald Trump expressed his support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino, stating it would be a 'terrible mistake' for FIFA to replace him. This endorsement comes after an open letter from three soccer federations—UEFA, CONCACAF, and AFC—accused Infantino of a 'fundamental breach of trust' regarding his handling of the sale of World Cup commercial rights.
key_facts: Donald Trump supports Gianni Infantino as FIFA president.

The letter criticizes Infantino's conduct regarding World Cup commercial rights.

timeline_highlights.title: FIFA Confirms Departure of COO Following Criticism of Infantino's Plans
timeline_highlights.summary: FIFA has confirmed the departure of Chief Operating Officer Kevin Lamour, who publicly criticized President Gianni Infantino's proposal to sell a stake in its tournament business, including the World Cup. This announcement comes weeks after Lamour's remarks against the plan, which has faced opposition from various football confederations and member countries.

event_overview.title: About the 2026 FIFA World Cup
event_overview.subject: FIFA World Cup
event_overview.summary: The FIFA World Cup is FIFA’s flagship men’s national-team football tournament, held in periodic editions and contested by teams that qualify through their regional confederations, alongside host nations. The 2026 edition was the first to use a 48-team format and was staged across Canada, Mexico and the United States from 11 June to 19 July 2026.

facts.label: Scale and venues
facts.value: The 2026 tournament used 16 host cities across the three host countries.

facts.label: Format
facts.value: For the first time, 48 teams competed in 12 groups of four. The top two in each group plus the eight best third-placed teams advanced to a round of 32, producing a 104-match tournament.

facts.label: 2026 outcome
facts.value: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, defeating the defending champions Argentina in the final at New York New Jersey Stadium.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers late-July and early-August 2026 debate over proposed investment or ownership arrangements connected to the World Cup; it does not provide a full account of the tournament, its matches, or FIFA’s broader history and governance.

related_stories.title: Presley Gerber died at age 27
related_stories.summary: Presley Gerber, the 27-year-old son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and entrepreneur Rande Gerber, has died. A family spokesperson confirmed his death, which is currently being investigated as a suspected overdose. Gerber was found unresponsive at a rehabilitation facility in Los Angeles shortly after checking in.

related_stories.title: Investigation Requested into Juror in Lindsay Clancy Case
related_stories.summary: Lindsay Clancy's attorney has filed a motion requesting the court to investigate a juror who was a holdout during her murder trial, which ended in a mistrial. The motion seeks to examine the juror's cellphone use during deliberations and assess the accuracy of his responses on pre-trial questionnaires and during questioning by the judge.

related_stories.title: Typhoon Dujuan Causes Deaths and Destruction in Japan
related_stories.summary: Typhoon Dujuan has resulted in at least four fatalities and 22 injuries in Japan, with reports of six individuals missing. The storm brought record rainfall and violent winds, leading to landslides and significant power outages affecting thousands of homes near Tokyo. As the typhoon moves away, authorities have begun to downgrade heavy rain and landslide warnings.
